name: Mendicant Core
description: The captain of the Guidelight Voyagers automatons swallowed in the storm.

timeline.summary: A huge dust storm swallows the Guidelight Voyagers as the others flee through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: In the rearview mirror, Spitfire watches the Guidelight Voyagers, automatons captained by Mendicant Core, as they're swallowed up in the storm.

pages_say.description: The captain of the Guidelight Voyagers automatons swallowed in the storm.
